## What's fixed

- **The widget stays still when you play or pause.** Tapping play or pause on the Now Playing widget no longer pushes the times, the buttons and the Up next list down and back up again — on every size, small to extra large. The large widget keeps showing all four songs up next while music plays, instead of dropping the last one.

## Install

Download **Kultr.ipa** below and install it with **Sideloadly** (Windows, Mac), **AltStore** (Windows, Mac) or **Impactor** (Linux) — or with no computer at all, through **SideStore** installed by **SideInstaller** (only from sideinstaller.net) with **LocalDevVPN** connected. Or add the source `https://gist.githubusercontent.com/evropiani/6e3a3c18525a228d03924674430c4d48/raw/evropiani.json` in SideStore and update from there.

Installing over an earlier version keeps your servers, library, listening history, analysis and downloads — install it with the same Apple ID and don't delete the old app first.
